positions.description: Skills: Heroku · Software Design · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · Django · Research and Development (R&D) · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · htmx

positions.title: VP of Engineering
positions.description: Working closely with the CEO to set and execute the vision for the Engineering organization

positions.title: Engineering Lead
positions.description: As the Engineer Lead on the team I worked closely with the CTO. I mentored and led the team on a variety of projects including Dynamic Pricing, Staff Tools UI, Performance enhancements to the Mobile App, Built AuthZ and AuthN to all systems.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Led multiple projects on the Fund Admin and Financial Products teams. Including KYC/AML solution for LPs, Portfolio Management tool, and Capital Call and Distributions for investment funds

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Helped create new business unit to support Fund Administration clients, allowing Carta to expand its offering and grow the business for investors

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented first version of Capital Call and Distribution tools allowing investors to move money and communicate with their stakeholders using Carta Platform.

positions.title: Interim Chief Executive Officer, Brazil office
positions.description: Worked close with business team on the US and the CEO to open the first Brazilian entity for eShares (Carta).

positions.locationName: Rio de Janeiro e Região, Brasil

positions.title: Developer, DevOps Team
positions.description:
Use Jenkins to configure and run over 25 applications in order to simplify and shorten the deployment process.

Create and configure new environments and build back-end applications with the DevOps team.

Implement a single sign-on (SSO) solution for the company’s authentication system in order to create a better user experience.

Work closely with product owners and user experience designers in an agile environment to ensure projects are completed on time and in budget.

Orient and mentor interns and junior developers.

positions.title: Web Developer I
positions.description:
Built content management systems that provide content to Globosat’s APIs and allow clients to easily manage and organize video assets.

Developed and maintained websites for Globosat's multiple television channels in a team-oriented and deadline-driven setting.

Created REST API using Python and Django to provide data to all Globosat VoD platforms, Android and iOS devices, smart TVs and video games.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
Led the implementation of a system in PHP that registers, optimizes and packages more than five thousand assets for all Globosat partners.

Developed features and fixed bugs for Globosat’s websites using JAVA, PHP, Javascript, HTML and CSS.

projects.title: Muu VoD
projects.description: Site de VoD(Vídeos on Demand) com os conteúdos dos canais Globosat.
